=== screen 14 ===
 File  Edit  Insert  Find  Character  Paragraph  Document  Help                 
                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            hQuill: a plain document                            
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

 File  Edit  Insert  Find  Character  Paragraph  Document  Help                 
                           heQuill: a plain document                            
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                           helQuill: a plain document                           
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                          hellQuill: a plain document                           
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                          helloQuill: a plain document                          
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                         hello Quill: a plain document                          
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, writtezn in Rust. This paragraph is long enough           
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.
